full_prompt_en: A square monochrome surreal image shows a vast vertical wall covered with countless repeated human head forms. The wall occupies the left side and rises beyond the top edge, then narrows toward a distant vanishing point near the middle right. Each small head projects slightly from the rough surface, so rows of faces create a dense, uneven relief rather than a flat printed pattern. The nearest heads at the left edge remain large enough to suggest closed eyes, noses, and mouths; farther rows compress into a granular dark texture. Three solitary figures in dark, plain suits stand on the barren ground to its right. One smaller figure approaches the wall in the lower left, standing only a step away from the relief. A second person stands near the center-right foreground in clear side profile facing the wall, while a third appears smaller farther back against the horizon. Their silhouettes are still, with little visible facial detail, and they establish the overwhelming scale of the structure. A long dark shadow from the central figure stretches diagonally toward the lower left across the dusty ground. Behind them, bright broken clouds open above a low horizon, but the upper left remains in heavy shade. Raking side light grazes the relief, picking out irregular rounded edges and leaving its cavities in black. The scene has a grainy, low-key black-and-white finish with strong silver highlights on clouds and pale gray ground. The composition leans on a severe contrast between an immense repetitive mass and isolated upright human marks. The atmosphere is ominous and contemplative, like a silent encounter with a monument whose scale cannot be measured at a glance.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑白超现实图像描绘一堵布满无数重复人头形体的巨大垂直墙壁。墙占据左侧并伸出上边缘，随后朝画面中右部附近的远处消失点收窄。每颗小头颅都从粗糙表面略微凸出，成排面孔形成密集而不平整的浮雕，而不是平面的印花。左边缘最近的头颅足以看出闭合的眼、鼻子和嘴；远处各排则压缩成颗粒般的深色肌理。三位穿朴素深色套装的孤独人物站在墙右侧的荒地上。一位较矮的人物走近左下的墙面，距离浮雕只有一步。第二人立于中央偏右前景，以清晰侧面朝向墙壁；第三人更小，站在远处地平线前。他们的剪影一动不动，面部细节很少可见，也为建筑提供令人震动的尺度。中央人物的长深色影子斜向左下，伸过布满尘土的地面。身后明亮破碎的云层在低矮地平线上方打开，而左上仍笼罩浓重阴影。斜射侧光擦过浮雕，挑出不规则圆形边缘，凹处则沉入黑色。画面呈有颗粒的低调黑白质感，云层有强烈银白高光，地面是浅灰色。构图依靠庞大重复块体与孤立直立人形标记之间的严厉反差。气氛不祥而沉思，像一次与一眼无法丈量的纪念物进行的无声相遇。
style_prompt_en: Surreal black-and-white image making combines monumental repetition with spare, human-scale markers. A vast textured plane dominates one side and recedes sharply into depth; repeated rounded relief forms turn gradually from recognizable objects into dark grain. A few thin upright silhouettes on open ground establish scale and stillness without crowding the frame. The palette is restricted to black, charcoal, dusty gray, and silver white. Raking light catches projecting edges while recessed spaces stay nearly black, and dramatic clouds supply irregular luminous masses behind the severe geometry. Long diagonal shadows tie the small figures to the ground plane and push the eye toward the vanishing point. Fine grain and rough stone-like texture keep the image tactile, while strong perspective and extensive negative space sustain its unnerving calm. The visual effect depends on scale disparity, rhythmic accumulation, and restrained cinematic light.
style_prompt_zh: 超现实黑白图像把纪念碑般的重复结构与稀疏的人尺度标记结合。巨大的有肌理平面占据一侧并急速向深处退去；反复出现的圆形浮雕逐渐从可识别物体化作深色颗粒。开阔地面上寥寥几道细长直立剪影建立尺度与静止感，又不会挤满画面。色盘限制在黑色、炭灰、尘灰和银白。斜射光挑亮凸起边缘，凹处近乎全黑；戏剧性云层在严整几何背后提供不规则亮块。长斜影把小形体连到地面，并把视线推向消失点。细颗粒与石质般粗糙肌理让图像可以触摸，强透视和大量留白则维持令人不安的平静。视觉效果依靠尺度悬殊、节奏性累积和克制的电影式照明。
theme_en: Three dark figures confront a towering wall of repeated stone heads
theme_zh: 三名深色人影面对一堵由重复石质头颅构成的高墙
name: Misha Gordin
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
